description: Canonical location taxonomy for the geographic360 projection (Phase 4) — the program's ONE new canonical geography authority. Owns location roles, the region-type hierarchy (not US-only), the precision ladder (aligned to the context-capsule coarse_cell taxonomy), coordinate reference systems, and spatial-cell schemes. Generated artifacts: packages/shared/location-registry.ts, Backend Architecture/aether-backend/shared/geo/generated_taxonomy.py, docs/_generated/location-registry-table.md (via scripts/generate_platform_contracts.py). Coordinates live only here and on LocationFact records — never in context capsules (LocationObservation/ContextCapsule keep their no-raw-IP / no-lat-lon invariant).
